title: Public demo contract still resolves through login and the app workbench instead of a signed-out /demo/syria-2024 route
evidence: Contract: C:\Users\giuli\Downloads\PRAXIS_ARCHITECTURE.md:196 defines demo (/demo/syria-2024) as public, read-only, watermarked.

Contract: C:\Users\giuli\Downloads\PRAXIS_CODEX_14_PRODUCTION_EXCELLENCE.md:33 and :548 require /demo/syria-2024 to be signed-out, read-only, no auth; :571 requires CSP locked/no auth; :587 lists src/app/demo/syria-2024/page.tsx and layout.tsx.
Repo: src/app/demo/page.tsx:4 redirects /demo to /app/workbench/syria-2026?tab=chapters; src/app/demo/syria-2024/page.tsx and layout.tsx do not exist.
Repo: src/proxy.ts:164-170 sends unsigned /demo/* traffic to /login?mode=demo&example=syria-2026; src/proxy.ts:193 allows demo sessions through /app/*.
Production HTTP no-follow: https://praxis.tacitus.me/demo -> 307 /login?mode=demo&example=syria-2026; https://praxis.tacitus.me/demo/syria-2024 -> 307 /login?mode=demo&example=syria-2026.

Production browser: visiting /demo or /demo/syria-2024 auto-created a demo session and ended at https://praxis.tacitus.me/app/workbench/syria-2026?tab=chapters with h1 'Syria Transition - Northeast Integration & Regional Spillover'. Console had no app errors; observed failures were analytics/RSC abort noise.
remediationSketch: Either update the architecture/Pack 14 source of truth to make the login-created /app/workbench/syria-2026 demo the accepted contract, or implement the specified /demo/syria-2024 route as a signed-out, read-only, watermarked demo surface with no auth requirement and route-local isolation. Keep redirects explicit and add an e2e test that validates direct signed-out /demo/syria-2024 access.

title: Login route does not implement the documented magic-link primary entry flow
evidence: Contract: C:\Users\giuli\Downloads\PRAXIS_ARCHITECTURE.md:31 says a user signs in via magic link; :198 defines waitlist or magic-link (/login); :305 lists login/page.tsx + callback as magic link via Identity Platform.

Contract: C:\Users\giuli\Downloads\PRAXIS_CODEX_14_PRODUCTION_EXCELLENCE.md:34 requires waitlist + magic-link signup; :58 proposes email-link primary and no password; :601 says magic-link primary with password retained only as fallback.
Repo: src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx renders Continue with Google, email/password sign in/sign up, forgot password, and Open example case workspace. It does not expose a magic-link send/consume path.
Repo absence check: src/lib/auth/magic-link.ts, src/components/onboarding/SixtySecondWow.tsx, e2e/onboarding/60-second-wow.spec.ts, and tests/e2e/onboarding/60-second-wow.spec.ts are missing.
Production browser /login displayed Google, email/password, reset, sign-up, and demo controls; no magic-link CTA or callback flow was visible.
remediationSketch: Decide whether password-based auth is the actual v1 contract. If not, add Identity Platform email-link issue/consume routes, a callback route, rate limiting, waitlist approval wiring, and e2e coverage for the no-password first-win flow. If passwords are intentionally retained, update the architecture and Pack 14 language so audits do not treat the current login page as drift.

title: Unauthenticated health routes are inconsistent about how much operational detail they expose
evidence: Production HTTP: /api/health returned 200 with status ok and safeguards; /api/health/feeds returned 200 with individual feed statuses including gdelt, reliefweb, hdx, unhcr, worldbank, ucdp, unnews, sipri, crisisgroup, and google_search.
Production HTTP: /api/health/provider returned 401 and /api/capabilities returned 401, confirming some diagnostic/provider surfaces are auth-gated.
Repo: src/app/api/health/feeds/route.ts returns NextResponse.json without withAuth; src/app/api/health/provider/route.ts:36 uses withAuth.
Contract: C:\Users\giuli\Downloads\PRAXIS_ARCHITECTURE.md:208 scopes diagnostics, users, ops, and cost to owner-only admin.
remediationSketch: Keep a minimal unauthenticated uptime endpoint if needed, but move detailed dependency/feed/provider state behind authenticated admin diagnostics or return a coarse ok/degraded summary publicly. Document the intended public health contract so monitors and audits agree.

title: Real Firebase user, onboarding completion, admin-verified session, and paid/user-secret flows were not testable in this audit
evidence: No test user credentials, Firebase test account, admin verified account, or secrets were provided in the audit brief.
Paid AI/API spend was constrained to $0, so AI POST routes and paid provider flows were not exercised.

Production unauthenticated checks verified expected gates: /api/capabilities -> 401, /api/admin/me -> 401, /api/admin/domains -> 401, /api/admin/diagnostics -> 401, /app/admin -> 307 /login?redirect=%2Fapp%2Fadmin.
Production browser demo checks verified only the demo-session path, not real user token refresh, first-login onboarding redirect, admin verified content, or user-owned data isolation.
remediationSketch: Provide a non-billing test Firebase user, a verified admin test principal, and a seeded test situation with no paid model calls. Add a dry-run credentialed smoke that covers /login -> /onboarding -> /app/workbench, /app/admin denial/allow, and representative authenticated GET APIs.

title: Assigned sibling worktree lacks dependencies; local dev required installed-worktree binaries and was not representative of a fresh standalone checkout
evidence: Initial npm run dev in C:\Users\giuli\praxis-audit-routes-and-user-flows failed with 'next is not recognized' because the sibling worktree has no node_modules.

Using C:\Users\giuli\praxiscodexworking\node_modules\.bin\next.cmd with default Turbopack failed: Next.js could not find next/package.json from the assigned worktree and reported possible workspace-root inference problems.

Workaround succeeded only with NODE_PATH=C:\Users\giuli\praxiscodexworking\node_modules and next dev --webpack -p 3026. Local selected checks then passed: /api/auth/session 200, /login 200, /app/workbench 307 to demo login, /demo 307 to demo login, /api/capabilities 401.
Webpack dev emitted OpenTelemetry dependency warnings and a missing @opentelemetry/exporter-jaeger resolution warning from the installed dependency tree.
remediationSketch: Do not install in this audit worktree. For future sibling-worktree audits, document a supported no-install command or keep a checked-in script that resolves binaries from the canonical installed worktree. Separately verify that a normal checkout with npm ci can run next dev without the NODE_PATH/webpack workaround.
